title: Same end states, different paths
statement:
Two paths connect the same thermodynamic states of a system. Which quantity must be the same for the two paths?

[_]{a}

choices: The external pressure at every intermediate point
explanations: Internal energy is a state function.
The paths can differ in intermediate conditions.

hints: Only the sum of the signed transfers is fixed.
solution: $\Delta E$ is fixed by the endpoints. Transfer by heat and by work may differ while their sum stays fixed.
